newsitem.title: UK: British unemployment falls 67,800 in January.
newsitem.headline: British unemployment falls 67,800 in January.

text.p: British unemployment fell 67,800 in January, giving a jobless rate of 6.5 percent, official figures showed on Wednesday.
They showed 1.82 million Britons were unemployed last month. The fall in the jobless total was 46,700 in December and the jobless rate was 6.7 percent.
Earlier a tabloid newspaper said a leak showed the jobless total had fallen 57,800 in January. The statistics office said it would launch an inquiry into the alleged leak.
The January jobless total was the lowest in six years. The fall was much larger than analysts had expected.
